summary: Frontend-only regression for the public /resources feature. Verified (1) anonymous visitors can view /resources without login (no redirect); (2) sidebar nav items greyed with lock icons and route to /login on click; (3) 'Free Resources' banner replaces org name; (4) 'Sign In' button (public-sign-in-btn) present instead of user avatar; (5) blue CTA banner (public-resources-cta) with signin link (public-resources-cta-signin) works; (6) other protected routes (/dashboard, /meetings, /admin, /settings, /super-admin) still redirect anonymous users to /login; (7) Logged-in admin (admin@supervision.com, cookies injected via get_tokens.py to bypass MFA) sees the FULL normal experience on /resources — real org name 'Test Company', working user-menu-btn with Sign out, nav items un-greyed and clickable navigating to /dashboard, no CTA banner, no public-sign-in-btn. All 8 requested test cases PASS. Only 1 console error observed on the logged-in page (a single unrelated 401 — likely a benign background request; NOT auth-blocking, page renders fully). No console errors on anonymous /resources.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js sidebar nav item Link uses data-testid derived from `label.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, '-')` which produces correct testids (nav-dashboard, nav-meetings, nav-new-meeting, nav-my-portfolio) as expected; no issue but a per-item explicit testId prop would be more robust to future label copy changes.
